goldens.comment: The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.
goldens.reasoning: C1 describes the same issue: the reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can run before exceptions are recorded.

candidates: Race condition: the reader thread is never joined before the assertion. After deletedAll.set(true), the main thread immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty, but the reader thread may still be mid-request inside groups(). If that in-flight call throws an exception, it gets added to caughtExceptions after the assertion has already passed, making the test silently miss the exact failures it is designed to detect.
